scientific_integrity: Explicit analytic proof plus separately implemented direct-matrix finite checks; no claim of computational certification of the infinite statement. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Full, equal-weight, antipodal pairs of interior Hamming shells only; Walsh degrees at most two, conditional probability normalization. The original operator has one radial null direction, so stability is asserted only on its orthogonal complement. Square-dimensional global optimization compares only those shell pairs, not arbitrary sampling designs; no claims for finite random samples or higher bandwidth. Historical originality subject to expert priority review.
title: Antipodal Hamming-shell Walsh frames: five spectral bands and a sharp square-dimensional design
